name: penopta
description: Search Penopta project context in chat and keep ChatGPT/Codex threads in sync.

interface.shortDescription: Keep ChatGPT project threads in sync with Penopta for search, context, and handoffs.
interface.longDescription: Penopta connects ChatGPT to your Penopta workspace so agent project work stays searchable and shareable. After you sign in with Penopta, ChatGPT can verify the connection, discover projects, sync opted-in project threads, pull project context into chat, and push a single conversation on demand. Identity and org come from OAuth — no API key to paste. Transcript sync only covers projects you choose to track in Penopta; private projects named with a P: or Private: prefix are never registered or synced.
